en: The postcard features a sepia-toned historical photograph of a large, ornate palace with a domed roof, situated at the center of a grand public square with horse-drawn carriages and people walking. The image is surrounded by handwritten text in black ink, written in a script that appears to be Swedish. The reverse side provides address lines and multilingually printed text for 'Postcard', along with a red postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich (Germany), Berlin cancellation mark, and the address written in cursive.
